request.description:
**Description:** Create a new user with username, email, and password.

---

**Method:** POST

**URL:** {{baseUrl}}/auth/register

---

## **Example Request:**

``` json
{
    "username": "username1",
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "password": "password123"
}

 ```

---

## **Example Response:**

**Status:** 201 Created

**Body:** (empty)

---

_**Verification link sent to user's email.**_

**Description:** Authenticates user credentials and returns JWT tokens.

---

**Method:** POST

**URL:** {{baseUrl}}/auth/login

---

## **Example Request:**

``` json
{
    "usernameOrEmail": "username1",
    "password": "password123"
}

 ```

---

## **Example Response:**

**Status:** 200 OK

**Body:**

``` json
{
    "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..."
}

 ```

_And_ _**refreshToken**_ _in the Cookies_

**Description:** Generates a new access token using the refresh token.

---

**Method:** POST

**URL:** {{baseUrl}}/auth/refresh

---

## **Example Request:**

**Required Cookies:** refreshToken

---

## **Example Response:**

**Status:** 200 OK

**Body:**

``` json
{
    "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..."
}

 ```

**Description:** Verifies user's email address using a verification token.

---

**Method:** GET

**URL:** {{baseUrl}}/auth/verify-email?token=verification_token_here

---

## **Example Response:**

**Status:** 204 No Content

**Body:** (empty)

**Description:** Resends email verification link to the user.

---

**Method:** POST

**URL:** {{baseUrl}}/auth/resend-email-verification

---

## **Example Request:**

``` json
{
    "email": "user@example.com"
}

 ```

---

## **Example Response:**

**Status:** 202 Accepted

**Body:** (empty)

---

_**Verification link sent to user's email.**_

**Description:** Initiates password reset process by sending OTP to email.

---

**Method:** POST

**URL:** {{baseUrl}}/auth/forget-password

---

## **Example Request:**

``` json
{
    "email": "user@example.com"
}

 ```

---

## **Example Response:**

**Status:** 202 Accepted

**Body:** (empty)

---

_**OTP sent to user's email.**_

**Description:** Verifies the OTP sent to user's email for password reset.

---

**Method:** POST

**URL:** {{baseUrl}}/auth/forget-password/verify-otp

---

## **Example Request:**

``` json
{
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "code": "328450"
}

 ```

---

## **Example Response:**

**Status:** 200 OK

**Body:**

``` json
{
    "resetToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..."
}

 ```

item.name: Reset Forgotten Password After OTP Verification

request.description:
**Description:** Resets the password using the reset session token.

---

**Method:** POST

**URL:** {{baseUrl}}/auth/forget-password/reset-password

---

## **Example Request:**

``` json
{
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "resetToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
    "newPassword": "password123"
}

 ```

---

## **Example Response:**

**Status:** 204 No Content

**Body:** (empty)

**Description:** Invalidates the current JWT token and terminates the user session.

---

**Method:** POST

**URL:** {{baseUrl}}/auth/logout

---

## **Example Request:**

**Required Headers:** Authorization (Bearer {{accessToken}})

---

## **Example Response:**

**Status:** 204 No Content

**Body:** (empty)

**Description:** Retrieves a paginated list of users with optional sorting.

---

**Method:** GET

**URL:** {{baseUrl}}/users

---

## **Example Request:**

**Required Headers:** Authorization (Bearer {{accessToken}})

---

## **Example Response:**

**Status:** 200 OK

**Body:**

``` json
{
    "content": [
        {
            "id": 1,
            "username": "mahmoud2617",
            "email": "mm2617d@gmail.com",
            "role": "ADMIN"
        },
        {
            "id": 2,
            "username": "username1",
            "email": "user@gmail.com",
            "role": "USER"
        }
    ],
    "empty": false,
    "first": true,
    "last": true,
    "number": 0,
    "numberOfElements": 2,
    "pageable": {
        "offset": 0,
        "pageNumber": 0,
        "pageSize": 20,
        "paged": true,
        "sort": {
            "empty": false,
            "sorted": true,
            "unsorted": false
        },
        "unpaged": false
    },
    "size": 20,
    "sort": {
        "empty": false,
        "sorted": true,
        "unsorted": false
    },
    "totalElements": 2,
    "totalPages": 1
}

 ```

---

_**Available for Admins only**_

**Description:** Retrieves the authenticated user's data.

---

**Method:** GET

**URL:** {{baseUrl}}/users/me

---

## **Example Request:**

**Required Headers:** Authorization (Bearer {{accessToken}})

---

## **Example Response:**

**Status:** 200 OK

**Body:**

``` json
{
    "id": 1,
    "username": "mahmoud2617",
    "email": "mm2617d@gmail.com",
    "role": "ADMIN"
}

 ```

**Description:** Changes the username for the currently authenticated user.

---

**Method:** PATCH

**URL:** {{baseUrl}}/users/change-username

---

## **Example Request:**

``` json
{
    "newUsername": "username1new"
}

 ```

**Required Headers:** Authorization (Bearer {{accessToken}})

---

## **Example Response:**

**Status:** 204 No Content

**Body:** (empty)

**Description:** Changes the password for the currently authenticated user.

---

**Method:** PATCH

**URL:** {{baseUrl}}/users/change-password

---

## **Example Request:**

``` json
{
    "currentPassword": "password123",
    "newPassword": "password123new"
}

 ```

**Required Headers:** Authorization (Bearer {{accessToken}})

---

## **Example Response:**

**Status:** 204 No Content

**Body:** (empty)

**Description:** Deletes a user account (accessible by the user themselves or an admin).

---

**Method:** DELETE

**URL:** {{baseUrl}}/users/:userId

---

## **Example Request:**

**Required Headers:** Authorization (Bearer {{accessToken}})

---

## **Example Response:**

**Status:** 204 No Content

**Body:** (empty)
